data.text: Verify users during signup and high-value actions to prevent fake accounts, misuse, and payment abuse, ensuring a secure and compliant subscriber base for your platform.
Detect fraudulent transactions, reduce chargebacks, and ensure compliant subscriber onboarding for subscription and pay-per-view models, protecting your revenue and user trust.
Automate revenue-sharing payouts to creators, studios, and partners with verified onboarding, built-in reconciliation, and comprehensive audit trails for full transparency and compliance.
Enable secure creator onboarding, real-time fraud checks, and automated settlements for live streaming and events platforms, ensuring smooth operations.
Verify publishers, prevent impression fraud, and automate payouts to content partners for ad-supported OTT platforms, optimizing ad revenue and trust.
Support compliant onboarding and payouts across regions with scalable verification workflows, enabling seamless global OTT expansion and market entry.
